verdict.rationale: The only hint of multi-item processing is the Nexus API supporting creation of 'one or more' declarations in a call; the MCP and REST docs otherwise describe single-transaction creation and per-item tax-code suggestions (1-3 per query), with no documented batch/bulk transaction, bulk calculation, or bulk import endpoint for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: a dedicated batch/bulk transaction API, bulk calculation across many line items, and evidence of AI agents invoking such bulk operations via MCP.
